Quantum optics & precision measurement

Begüm

Postdoctoral Associate
MIT Kavli Institute & MIT LIGO Laboratory

I develop experiments and models to understand and control quantum measurements in real optical systems. Using Advanced LIGO as a platform, I study squeezed light, measurement back-action, and quantum-noise correlations.

01 / Research

Quantum measurements.
Real optical systems.

My research combines quantum optics, precision interferometry, and physically interpretable modeling to study how quantum fluctuations and correlations shape the information available from a measurement.

Quantum measurement & back-action

I use Advanced LIGO to investigate measurement imprecision, radiation-pressure back-action, and the correlations between them. My work combines squeezed-light enhancement, quantum reservoir engineering, and advanced optical readout to understand and control quantum measurements of macroscopic motion.

Nonlinear & multimode photonics

My doctoral research investigated soliton self-mode conversion, coherence, and energetic ultrafast frequency generation in multimode fibers. I have also worked on structured light and spatial combs, exploring how control of spatial and temporal modes can expand the capabilities of optical systems.

Looking ahead. My broader goal is to understand and engineer quantum information flow in complex physical systems through the joint design of input states, interactions, and measurements.

03 / Research software

Open-source tools for modeling, visualizing, and interpreting quantum measurements in precision interferometers.

Modeling & visualization

LIGO Quantum Tools ↗

Tools for exploring squeezed states, quantum noise, and quantum measurements in precision interferometers.

Data analysis & spectral fitting

Kilogram-Scale Quantum Back-Action Analysis ↗

Research software accompanying the kilogram-scale back-action study, including an interactive GWINC-based interface for fitting measured quantum-noise spectra.

My modeling work uses GWINC, FINESSE, Python, MATLAB, and Bayesian and MCMC-based parameter estimation.
